message:
The other day, we found ourselves rummaging through our old board games while organizing our go-bags. It was a delightful trip down memory lane, filled with laughter and friendly competition. As we played, it struck us how much joy simple moments can bring, especially when life gets a little unpredictable. 

In the midst of our preparations, we realized that rediscovering low-tech fun can also be a part of being ready. It’s comforting to know that while we gather supplies and make plans, we can also create memories that remind us of the strength and joy in our family. What’s your favorite way to unwind together?
